resources.string: Settings related to floating-icon appearance, position, and visibility.
Keep a floating icon on both sides of the screen.
Move the icon to the nearest screen edge when dragging ends.
Recall by swiping from the edge
After hiding, swipe inward from the screen edge to restore the icon.
Tap the screen below the icon
Useful when pass-through-style tapping is needed.
Normal dragging only moves the icon temporarily. After using the Move floating icon action, the next drag saves the new position.
Timing thresholds and visual feedback are separated to make tuning easier.
Configure standard screenshot OCR and YFloat native region-recognition OCR separately. Google screen-recognition settings are under Advanced permissions, LSPosed.
Status-bar and navigation-bar choices apply to standard screenshots, OCR region screenshots, and region-recognition mode.
When disabled, standard screenshots and region recognition exclude the visible status-bar area.
When disabled, standard screenshots and region recognition exclude the navigation bar. When enabled, both keep it.
Standard screenshot backend. Root and LSPosed screenshot enhancements are configured separately under Advanced permissions.
Border corners adapt to the current device and orientation. The border only indicates active mode and is hidden automatically while YFloat captures the screen.
These OCR settings apply only to YFloat native region recognition. Google mode uses Google recognition, selection, and target analysis.
This OCR engine controls standard screenshot OCR and does not control region-recognition mode.

Tiny is suitable for fast full-screen indexing or lightweight correction. Small is balanced. Medium offers the highest accuracy but is slower. Download a PP model before selecting it for full-screen or correction use. Tiny is about 7 MB, Small about 32 MB, and Medium about 139 MB.
Local model management is temporarily unavailable. ML Kit remains available.

Standard screenshot OCR and region recognition share this language selection. ML Kit chooses recognizers from enabled languages. Simplified and Traditional Chinese share Chinese recognition support. Keep at least one language enabled.
